task_completion.description: The agent creates the Tcl/Tk script file at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command or text editor showing the creation of '~/Documents/element_browser.tcl'.

task_completion.description: The agent executes the script using the 'wish' command and a window appears.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal showing 'wish ~/Documents/element_browser.tcl' followed by a new GUI window appearing on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The GUI contains a search entry, a listbox, and a detail panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The application window shows an input field at the top, a vertical list of items, and a labeled area for element details.

task_completion.description: The listbox is populated with element names from the CSV (Hydrogen, Helium, etc.).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The listbox component is not empty and displays names of chemical elements (1-36).

task_completion.description: The search entry field filters the listbox items as text is entered.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show text being typed into the search bar and the number of items in the listbox decreasing to match the query.

task_completion.description: Clicking an element updates the detail panel with atomic number, symbol, name, weight, category, and phase.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An element is selected in the listbox, and the detail panel displays specific data (e.g., 'Atomic Number: 1', 'Symbol: H') corresponding to that element.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the GUI elements rather than just printing data to the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor positioning over the GUI listbox or entry field and subsequent visual changes in the application window.

integrity.description: The application displays data from the CSV, not just a static image or hardcoded single-element UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The listbox contains multiple elements (up to 36) and changes dynamically when different items are clicked.

integrity.description: The script is run from the specified file path using the correct interpreter.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal command shows 'wish' being used on the file located in '~/Documents/'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The periodic table data for elements 1-36 must be read from ~/Documents/periodic_table.csv. Element 1 is Hydrogen (H, 1.008), Element 6 is Carbon (C, 12.011), and Element 36 is Krypton (Kr, 83.798). The detail panel must show all six required fields: atomic number, symbol, name, atomic weight, category, and phase.
